heading: Today
text: Mostly sunny and milder.  A bit breezy in the Champlain Valley.  Highs in the 50s to low 60s.  Light winds east of the Green Mountains, and south winds from the Green Mountains west 10 to 15 mph, gusting to 25 mph, diminishing through the afternoon.

heading: Tonight
text: Mostly clear, except a few patches of clouds north, and some high clouds in southeast NH and MA.  Lows in the 30s.  Winds shifting to the north, mostly less than 10 mph, but gusting to 15 mph through the Champlain Valley.

heading: Tuesday
text: Sun, mixed with a few clouds north, and some high clouds through southeast NH, giving way to increasing afternoon sunshine.  Highs in the 50s north, upper 50s to low 60s south.  Winds light, mostly north to northeast, increasing to 10 to 15 mph through the Champlain and St. Lawrence valleys, gusting to 25 mph.
